name: Vietnam short swing ML LAB
scope: Local research and paper evidence; no database, SAG, broker, deployment or live capital actions
stage_exit: Verify a numeric source contract, payload coverage, units, availability timestamps and missing/default semantics for a specific economic hypothesis before enabling algorithm research

inspected_periods.reason: Existing ML research, source exports and PROD results already inspected; never a fresh holdout

universe_counterfactuals.comparison: Same decision dates, policy, capital, costs, settlement and eligibility controls; count all three trials
universe_counterfactuals.unknown_membership: VN30_ATTRIBUTION_UNAVAILABLE; never treat unknown membership as non-VN30
universe_counterfactuals.current_snapshot_backfill: Forbidden; historical membership and listing/delisting coverage are required

criteria.research_assumption: 10% maximum drawdown is a research screening limit, not approved live risk
criteria.win_rate_role: Descriptive only; never a profitability gate
criteria.profit_confirmation: Offline output can never produce PROFIT_CONFIRMED; actual broker reconciliation and separate live authorization are required

required_data: Frozen local exports, feature metadata and numeric source catalog
families.question: Which Vietnamese numerical observations exist, are trustworthy, were available at decision time and can support a falsifiable swing hypothesis?

required_data: Existing daily export and rejected run artifacts
families.question: Audit what data can support a cash profitable swing decision and identify executable economic hypotheses

required_data: Daily raw and adjusted OHLC, continuous volume, exchange calendar
families.question: Does confirmed price and volume continuation survive settlement lock and all trading costs?

required_data: Daily raw and adjusted OHLC, continuous volume, exchange calendar
families.question: Does a liquidity shock followed by a confirmed reversal produce positive net action value?

required_data: Daily export, existing trade and cash ledgers
families.question: Does switching between BUY, HOLD, EXIT and cash improve net capital return under the same budget?

required_data: Historical dated VN30 membership, historical listing and delisting coverage
families.question: Holding policy, costs and capital fixed, does historical VN30 membership change net outcomes versus matched liquid cohorts?
